why: The whole figure turns: figure 3 is figure 1 upside down, figure 4 is a quarter turn, and figure 5 is back to figure 1. The book answer is option 5, which is the same as figure 4. Look at the black triangle and the side of the wheel-box to compare the options.
trick: For turning figures, follow one black part and the pointed side of the box together.
note: By the quarter-turn-clockwise rule (0, 90, 180, 270, 360 degrees) the second figure should be figure 1 turned 90 degrees clockwise: box on the right, hourglass on the left with the black triangle at the bottom = option B (2). The book key says E; it may be a misprint.
